Project.NAME: frontend-livecoding-tasks
Project.keywords: frontend, live-coding, knowledge-base, markdown, javascript, typescript, react
Project.annotation: Knowledge base of frontend live-coding tasks maintained primarily as Markdown documents with JavaScript, TypeScript, and React examples; tasks are not expected to run from the repository by default.

M-GOVERNANCE.NAME: ProjectGovernance
M-GOVERNANCE.purpose: Define authoring, delivery, student-card, collection synchronization, Markdown-only verification, and stop-condition rules for the repository.

export-authoringRules.PURPOSE: Expose concise focused and real-work authoring, temporary twenty-slug compatibility, worktree isolation, delivery, editor-profile, preservation, and collection synchronization requirements

export-verificationContracts.PURPOSE: Expose shared completion evidence and planned Phase and Gate 16 through 20 records without inferring implementation

const-conciseRoadmap.PURPOSE: Link the five existing modules through planned contract, 8 + 8 + 5 migration, catalog cutover, and local-audit phases

M-TASK-TEMPLATE.NAME: TaskTemplate
M-TASK-TEMPLATE.purpose: Define focused and real-work ConciseStudentTaskCard structures for copy-ready self-contained frontend task cards.

type-TaskMetadata.PURPOSE: Exact five fields and controlled values for technology, thematic collection, one of five formats, difficulty, and integer duration

type-ConciseStudentTaskCard.PURPOSE: Title, editor instruction, Условие, technology-dependent minimal starter or minimum HTML fragment plus JavaScript, three closed hints, concise solution, and closed five-field metadata; multi-file is real-work only and every included changed solution file is complete with its matching starter FILE path

type-TaskClass.PURPOSE: Focused one-action 10–30 minute task or sequential real-work 45–60 minute task

type-EditorProfile.PURPOSE: Programiz, CodePen, TypeScript Playground, or React TypeScript copy-run contract

export-taskSchema.PURPOSE: Expose both concise task-class orders, minimal-code and FILE rules, progressive disclosure, solution boundaries, and metadata

M-TASK-VALIDATION.NAME: TaskValidation
M-TASK-VALIDATION.purpose: Deduplicate candidates and validate new or migrated cards for structure, source-contract preservation, content, and local Markdown, collection, XML, and Beads synchronization.
M-TASK-VALIDATION.path: docs/task-validation-policy.md; Beads validation and technical wave-publication records

type-CandidateRegister.PURPOSE: Finite Beads inventory with stable candidate IDs and one validation decision per entry

type-CardMigrationEvidence.PURPOSE: Exactly slug, mode, editorProfile, sourceLearningGoal, sourcePrerequisite, sourceRuntimeAssumption, destinationLocations, targetEditorExpectedResult, targetEditorActualResult, and verdict in the matching card Beads issue; both targetEditor fields equal NOT_RUN: Markdown-only delivery and verdict derives from local deterministic checks

export-validateCandidate.PURPOSE: Apply task-class, concise structure, preservation, content, local-link, collection, XML, and Beads synchronization gates in addition to candidate validation; never open external editors or browsers

const-legacyCompatibility.PURPOSE: Permit legacy structure only for the exact twenty pre-existing task exports while Phases 16 through 19 are incomplete; compatibility is not concise migration PASS; Phase 19 scans before removal and repeats the identical scan after removal

M-TASK-LIBRARY.NAME: TaskLibrary
M-TASK-LIBRARY.purpose: Store the current twenty legacy-compatible cards while migrating them to concise focused cards and adding one concise real-work card.

type-TaskMetadataSet.PURPOSE: Collection of five-field task metadata records exposed to thematic and interview collections

export-taskCard.PURPOSE: Expose one complete copy-ready task card through GitHub; Phase 19 requires all twenty-one exports to conform to ConciseStudentTaskCard

const-cardMigrationState.PURPOSE: Historical Phases 10 through 15 implemented the prior verbose twenty-card redesign, thematic and optional interview membership, root cutover, and rendered audit

const-conciseMigrationState.PURPOSE: Track the new concise redesign as planned 8 + 8 + 5 waves with Markdown-only publication gates; Wave A and Wave B card facts become implemented when local deterministic checks pass

M-CATALOG.NAME: StudentCatalog
M-CATALOG.purpose: Own the root student hub plus thematic, interview, and planned real-work collection pages that lead students to task cards.

type-CollectionEntry.PURPOSE: Linked student title and exact integer duration copied from the card, plus one plain-language sentence only for thematic collections

export-studentIndex.PURPOSE: Expose the current four-block thirteen-collection hub and the Phase 19 target of ten thematic, three interview, and one real-work collection without duplicating card content

const-conciseCatalogTarget.PURPOSE: Phase 19 atomically targets twenty-one cards, fourteen collections, one supported users-api-list real-work projection, and four unchanged root headings
